Built a sealed room and not sure it's actually airtight? The §6Seal Detector§f lights up red when the room has any unsealed edges that would leak oxygen into vacuum.

Simple vanilla crafting recipe: redstone torches, glass pane, steel fan, and a comparator. The detector emits a redstone signal proportional to the leakage rate. A fully sealed room gives a §60§f signal, a leaking room gives §615§f.

Place one inside each room to test. Wire the output to a NOT gate and an alarm for automated leak detection. The detector also feeds into the Space Suit GUI, showing green for sealed, red for compromised.

§ePS:§f For complex bases, place one detector per 20x20 area. Multiple detectors don't interfere with each other.
